judgment: A contains B means that B's topic is a narrower instance of, or equivalent to, A's topic. Sharing examples or commonly occurring together is not enough. Judge category scope, not whether every arbitrary document mentioning B must mention A explicitly.
provenance: New manually constructed category descriptions, not generated HDBSCAN labels. All distinct ordered pairs within each domain are tested. Exact inputs and semantic judgments are frozen before TRUE inference; no between-domain easy negatives are added.

domains.rationale: Bread includes its varieties and the topic of baking bread. Gluten-free food includes gluten-free bread but also non-bread food. Sourdough can contain gluten or be gluten-free; gluten-free bread need not be sourdough. Bread baking is a process, whereas discussions of bread varieties need not concern baking. F4 and F5 describe the same variety. The bread/baking judgments use topical containment, not a claim that a process is literally a loaf.

categories.S5: Testing the security of web applications

domains.rationale: Testing can vary independently in target (web or other software), purpose (security or other behavior), and method (automated or manual). S4/S5 narrow both S2 and S3. Manual web security testing belongs to S4/S5 but not S6; automated desktop functional testing belongs to S6 but not S2/S3/S4/S5. Neither automation nor web software implies security testing.

Carbon taxes and emissions trading are different environmental-policy instruments; trading emissions allowances is not itself a tax. Taxes on corporate profits need not be environmental policy, and carbon taxes are levied on emissions rather than corporate profit. Environmental policy also covers non-tax regulation; taxes also cover non-environmental tax bases. Factual disputes about policy effectiveness are outside these category-scope judgments.

categories.P5: Raising money online for election campaigns

domains.rationale: Election fundraising and online political campaigning overlap in online election fundraising. Fundraising can occur offline; online campaigning can advocate without raising money. Door-to-door canvassing is political campaigning but neither necessarily fundraising nor online campaigning. Campaigning encompasses fundraising and canvassing activities; this is topical containment, not a causal or co-occurrence claim.

Coworker friendships belong to friendship and workplace relationships. Workplace mentoring is a workplace relationship but need not be friendship; coworkers can be friends without mentoring one another. Long-distance friends need not be coworkers, and coworkers can be friends nearby. Friendship and workplace relationships overlap without either containing the other. R4/R5 denote the same mentoring context.
